biggest_catch: This is a BUSINESS card — you need an eligible business to apply — and the offer is strictly time-limited: the account must be opened between September 17, 2026 and November 3, 2026, or there is no bonus at all.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the $3,000 threshold — only use business spending you already planned.
This is a business credit card: you must have an eligible business and apply as a business; it is not a consumer card.
Time-limited promotion: the account must be opened between September 17, 2026 and November 3, 2026 — after that window the bonus disappears.
Applying involves a hard credit inquiry; Huntington will pull your credit when you apply.
Carrying a balance at the card's regular APR erases the bonus — pay in full every month.
Balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like charges, money orders, gambling, checks, fees, and returns do not count as 'spend' toward the $3,000 threshold.
Allow up to two billing cycles for the bonus to be awarded; the account must be open and not in default at fulfillment.

steps: Confirm you have an eligible business — this is a business credit card, not a consumer card.
Open the official Huntington promo page https://www.huntington.com/landing-pages/credit-card/welcome/businessvoice400 and apply for the Voice Business Credit Card BEFORE November 3, 2026.
Complete the business application; Huntington runs a hard credit inquiry when you apply.
If approved, spend $3,000 on business purchases you were already planning within the first 90 days after account opening.
Pay the balance in full every month — carrying a balance at the regular APR destroys the bonus.
Allow up to two billing cycles for the 40,000 bonus points to post, then redeem for a $400 statement credit or direct deposit.
